reviews.text:
I cannot say enough wonderful things about Dr. Petersen and the team at Animal Dermatology Clinic in Dallas! Our sweet cat, Charlie, had been struggling with an inflammatory ear polyp for over a year, and we were desperate to find a solution that would finally bring him relief.

From our very first visit, Dr. Petersen demonstrated an incredible level of knowledge, professionalism, and compassion. She took the time to thoroughly explain the anatomy of Charlie’s ear, help me understand exactly what was happening, and walk me through all of our treatment options. She never made me feel rushed and genuinely cared about finding the best possible outcome for him.

Ultimately, her expertise and guidance led us to the surgeon who successfully performed Charlie’s ventral bulla osteotomy (VBO). What impressed me just as much was her willingness to coordinate with his surgeon and remain involved in his care, even beyond her own practice.

Thanks to Dr. Petersen, Charlie finally has the relief he deserves after such a long journey. I am beyond grateful for her dedication, compassion, and commitment to his well-being. It is rare to find a veterinarian who combines such exceptional expertise with such genuine care for both pets and their families.

Thank you, Dr. Petersen, for helping give our sweet boy his quality of life back! I wholeheartedly recommend her and Animal Dermatology Clinic to anyone seeking specialized veterinary care.
Staff and Dr. Garfield are all wonderful.   They provide excellent communication and quality care.
Eugene, we appreciate your fantastic feedback! It's great to know that our exceptional specialty care met your expectations. Your praise will be shared with our specialists.

Nice staff, good information.  Providing my girl with the help she needs.

I was a little irritated with my first visit since they told me to stop with her ear treatment before her visit, then her ear closed up, and they couldn't examine it properly.

Each visit after has been really helpful, albeit expensive.  Worth it as long as the treatments continue to be effective though!

Dr. Petersen is the most compassionate vet I've dealt with. She fully invests herself into the situation to do everything she can to help. My soul dog had pemphigus and she helped turn his situation around for the last 6 months of his life. Now, I have a rescue with long term skin needs due to his injury and I'm so grateful for the relationship I already have established with Dr. P in order to give Axel the best care possible!

The veterinarian was very knowledgeable, and the techs were friendly, helpful, and pleasant to work with. I felt confident in the doctor's expertise and appreciated the time spent discussing treatment options for my dog's allergies.

Unfortunately, my experience was overshadowed by a lack of transparency regarding costs. During my appointment, I expressed concerns about administering allergy shots because I struggle with anxiety related to giving injections. The medical staff reassured me multiple times that if the shots did not work out, switching to oral allergy drops would be simple and could be done easily by coming back to the clinic. We discussed this option for several minutes, and at no point was I informed that there would be an additional conversion fee to make the switch.

When I later contacted the clinic to change from the injections to the oral drops, I was surprised to learn that there would be a charge to convert the treatment. Had this fee been disclosed during my original appointment, I would have chosen the oral drops from the beginning rather than agreeing to try the shots first.

My frustration is with the fact that the charge was never mentioned when treatment options were being discussed. The repeated assurances that switching would be easy without disclosing the associated cost felt misleading and resulted in a disappointing customer experience. I believe patients should be given complete information about potential fees upfront so they can make fully informed decisions about their pet's care

**Update**
They ended up waiving the fee due to it not being disclosed up front which was great customer service on their end. Again, the initial frustration was only due to the nondisclosure but the vet and techs are amazing and very friendly

Fantastic care,  BUT... just know that every appointment will take roughly an hour and a half. (10-15 minutes with doc/nurse). I've never had an appt start on time and never stayed less than 1:20. Max visit was 2 hours. Even picking up meds is 10-15 minutes. They are amazing allergists, but the time is incredibly frustrating.  Plan ahead for that when you go.

Called yesterday left a message for them to return my call and they did at 5 o’clock in the evening and then with a referral I needed to see the doctor and she told me it wouldn’t be till next month and which is fine and then she turned around and with this horrible attitude and said that you do know there’s $100 deposit to book an appointment right? I replied with no I did not know that and I don’t have $100 to let y’all sit on for months on end that’s the craziest Thing I’ve ever heard of I mean $100 deposit for them to sit and wait for you to have an appointment 34 months down the road who does that?

I will say her attitude worked them right up out of that money because if she’s got that kind of attitude, I will take my animal somewhere else because that tells me a whole bunch about the Care. My pet will receive he needs to replace his office staff or something because get somebody with a better attitude . if you don’t like your job, find another one.
I took my Great Dane here and while they are booked for a month in advance the doctors and techs are all very attentive and professional!
Very good place

Everyone is competent and kind, they do a great job communicating what's next on very complicated situations, and they take amazing care of the animals. very glad that we get to work with this group of people trying to figure out my cat's skin issues.
Beautiful staff who bring compassion and care to our pets
Ear infection champs ! Plus many other things naturally but they saved my boy Henry from an extremely bad ear infection that normal clinics couldn’t remedy.

Our visit to Dr. Jennifer Petersen's clinic was very pleasant. We highly recommend them. We went because of an allergy concern for our pet Eros and were very pleased with the treatment plan recommended by Dr. Petersen. The cost was lower than other veterinarians I've visited. 🫶

Awesome veterinarian doctors who specialize in dermatology for pets. Doctors are in high demand and appointments can be a couple of months out. If your fur baby needs a good skin doctor, call ASAP to place yourself in their books. P.S if your pet is set for an allergy test don't feed or water 12 hours before procedure if not you will need to reschedule for another time which might not be immediate. Once your pet has been seen it's no problem whatsoever getting and refilling pet's prescriptions.

Brought my 18 year old kitty here to check out a  growth in her ear. We were seen promptly and the vet was great! Super sweet to our old girl. They were able to remove the growth the same day, which I appreciated as my cat gets a little stressed going anywhere outside of the house.  All in all, very positive experience and glad my primary vet recommended these specialists!
Dr. Ho and staff has been fantastic for past couple of years managing my dog's chronic allergy. I also really appreciate Dr. Ho's detailed explanation for treatment options
Dr Seals and her team were so caring with our dog and always made time to discuss her care with us. They sent us the sweetest card when she passed away. Highly recommend

Dr McCoy is the best veterinary doc I have ever met.  She is extremely focused on investigating the issue with your pet and she provides a very detailed course of action to help resolve issues.  Today, she called me on the phone with some test. results and I realized that I was not correctly following course of treatment - she was very gracious but helped me make corrections.  She does not order unnecessary tests but instead aims to prescribe a course of treatment that is both effective and efficient.  This Doc is best of the best and I am glad we were referred to her for care of our loved CavaPoo.

Dr. Ho is AMAZING! She completely changed my dog’s life. I had gone from vet to vet for years trying to find a solution for my poor, itchy, allergy-ridden pup. I honestly thought I was never going to find a solution for my girl 😞

Then I was referred to Dr. Ho a few years ago, and she has completely changed everything. She did proper allergy testing on my dog (as opposed to other, less reliable tests I’d had done before), and we were able to understand what triggers my dog’s allergies. Now, my dog has the right food and the right medications, and she is a much, MUCH happier and healthier dog. Her skin is less itchy, her ears aren’t as red and dirty, and she even started playing more like a puppy again.

Even when allergens do flare up or when my dog gets extra itchy during the summer, Dr. Ho is always really helpful and willing to give advice and offer new meds as needed.

I didn’t even know animal dermatology was a thing, and I am so happy and thankful that we found Dr. Ho. Not to mention that the entire staff at ADC is super kind and helpful! They always greet my dog like she’s their favorite (though I’m sure every dog is their favorite lol). It’s just really nice to see a team who cares about their patients so much and gives these pets all the love when coming in.

Thank you, Dr. Ho and the ADC staff!!

The wait time for first time patients and cost is completely worth it. Get on the list and pay the deposit. You wont regret it.

I never write a review but had to. We have been seeing Dr Ho and her team for a few months now. We had a severe issue with our english bulldog that no vet could solve. It was to the point we were considering if his pain was too much.

I truly wish i had went to Dr Ho sooner. Dr Ho and her team are simply amazing. They gave my 12yr old bulldog his life back !! He walks, plays and no longer has sores all over his body.  The team is so compassionate and will take the time to explore all options to help.

Fast and clear communication no matter what the issue may be. I honestly can not thank Dr Ho and her team enough. 5 out 5 stars is just not enough for giving my bulldog his quality of life back and more time with our family.

My pup has a skin condition that makes him very uncomfortable.  We saw Dr. Peterson and she was delightful. A very kind, compassionate and insightful vet.  She listened carefully, gave us considerable time and covered the range of things we and she can do for treating our Shih-Tsu.  He was drawn to her for the thoughtful and gifted care.

I recommend this vet group completely.  We have the fullest confidence that these folks are able to help us and you with your veterinary needs and concerns.
We have gotten our goldens allergies under control

If your dog is having tough allergy issues, especially if they are purebred, then this is the place to come. Yes, it is expensive, but if you bought a purebred dog, then you know what you signed up for.
The very best!
My poor Shitzu, sushi had been battling skin issues for almost a yr. Thanks to the doctor at this clinic she is doing so good. Highly recommend!
Amazing veterinarian here. They are so great with Newton and all his skin allergies

For most of his life, our Hava-Poo, Tucker, has struggled with skin problems. He’s been treated with several topical and oral medications as well as injections. Some of them worked, but he’d always break out again and we’d have to start treatment all over again. In 2023, his skin was the absolute worst it had ever been and nothing we would do made it any better. So we decided to take him in to see the Doggy Dermatologist.

We are very happy with how things have been going since we started the injections from Dr. Ho. When we first brought Tucker into the office (end of 2023), he was just covered in sores and he had them for nearly the entire year…no matter what we did to help!! And today his skin is soft and clear. I’ve gotten used to giving him his injections every other week. He’s such a good boy and just sits still for me… knowing he gets a reward afterward. His attitude has been amazing too. He’s been so happy with lots of zooming!!

I highly recommend getting your pet checked out if they have bad allergies. It’s been an amazing transformation. And we are now starting up our second dog since he’s been dealing with the itching as well (just wasn’t as bad). We see the Animal Dermatology Clinic in Dallas, but there’s also one in Grapevine.

Dr. Shanna Seals and staff were well worth the 6 hour drive to meet with in behalf of our beloved Jasper; referral from our very fine vet at home. Dr. Seals is very personable, knowledgeable and attentive! She was well versed with records provided for the referred appointment; and provided a thorough exam, tests, treatment and a path forward for better health for Jasper. I'm most appreciative of our time spent with her. We connected at the very start with mention of James Herriot... 😁🐾
Thank you very much for your help!!

Our bull terrier has been MISERABLE with allergies but two vets both said allergy testing and shots was “prohibitively expensive.” But 5 weeks ago after trying Apoquel, Cytopoint, antihystamines, eyedrops, eardrops, multiple rounds of antibiotics, different dog foods, and prednisone (which was adding up month after month) I called and left a message in desperation on a Sunday night. They called first thing in the morning & a week later we were on the road to recovery!

They have a sheet that lists your dog’s discomfort scale & I felt so sad because he was quite high on the scale. 😮😢💔 (The scale is helpful if you need to email between visits.)

First of all, they are VERY UPFRONT about the costs. It is all listed out for you. Second, they discuss different options. (We had pretty much tried all of those.)

The first visit he was given antibiotics, probiotics, an antifungal, a new food, shampoo, a steroid, eye drops, and ear drops to get him in good shape. (We could have just left him as he was & tested in a week. If given the opportunity for a do over, I would go that route but we desperately wanted him to feel better.) That first visit cost pretty much what every allergy vet visit cost at our regular vet. (The food was less expensive than Chewy!)

We had to wait to test until everything was out of his system. They sent emails in the meantime to check on him!❤️

Test day was simple. We left him for ~45 minutes. They lightly sedate & then test. Upon our return, they had everything bagged up for us. He got SIX months worth of treatment, plus antibiotics, probiotics, steroids, spray on steroids, and more food (we asked, they don’t push this at all-they had already called in a script to Chewy weeks before.) They sent a swab of the bacteria on his skin to grow in a lab to be sure we are giving him the best antibiotic. (This was optional & the choice was left up to us. He has been in multiple antibiotics so we definitely wanted to sort this out!)

We were told to email if we need anything. When I got home, there was even a sharps container in the bag. (That is the level of detail they give to your pet.)

It DOES take time for the shots to work (again VERY UPFRONT about what to expect).

Going forward, the allergy shots are 1/2 the monthly price of either Apoquel or Cytopoint (and don’t have the cancer risk those two drugs do).

If you are thinking about going this route but worry about the cost, the testing is more than a vet visit when your dog is itchy but the long term treatment is much less expensive without the long term health risks. (They do take CareCredit, so you could make payments.)

Your dog will continue to go to your regular vet. They get vet records BEFORE your first visit & they really do read it to see what you have already tried (& to subscribe a new antibiotic). They also send their visit notes to you and your vet while you are still in the office. If you need a script refill, they can call it into your local vet if you are far away from the office.

When we go, our dog is not dog friendly so they put him in an office right away. There was NO wait time either visit. The vet tech is super sweet. The phone is answered immediately.

My only regret is not taking him in for treatment when I first asked my vet for a referral. (And guess what? You don’t need a referral!!!)

Also, they are non-judgmental. They didn’t make me feel stupid for letting him get so bad (bald spots). They are so sweet to your pet.

10 Stars!!!
They are so friendly and great with my big dogs that hate going to the doctor. My dogs have skin conditions, and they fixed them right up!
Actually looked at the problems, offered options, used a microscope... Not enough places, animal and human, use microscopes anymore to find simple answers to questions.
The clinic is pretty busy, and appointments are 2 or 3 months out. My dog is being treated there for severe allergies. Doctor is pretty knowledgeable.

We are regulars at this office. Dr. Crow is wonderful with our dog. He gets down on the floor and talks with him. 🥹 vet techs are always super helpful and receptionists are also helpful. Love having this office in Grapevine! …

dr seals was amazing
My dog has since passed from skin cancer but we were always well treated during such a difficult time. I miss my pup every day but I am glad we were able to rely on ADC during the time we had together.
Very good clinic, excellent service. I recommend it.
Wonderful clinic that allergy tested our German shepherd and now she is itching free and happy
